# exporter-kit

> Write Prometheus exporters without client_golang: collect-on-scrape collectors, byte-exact text format 0.0.4, per-collector timeouts and up gauges Go module `github.com/Trysac/u135-exporter-kit`, package `exporterkit`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
